text:
Please contact poison control or a doctor right now about your toddler, before anything else. Peace lily is on our not-pet-safe list, and I don't have any other safety guidance for it, so they're the right people to advise you. Keep the plant out of reach in the meantime.

On the order, a smashed pot counts as damaged on arrival. Report it within 48 hours of delivery with photos of the plant and the box. You can then choose a free replacement on the next plant shipping day, or a refund. A replacement doesn't use up your Plant Care Guarantee replacement.

Once your toddler has been looked after, send the photos and tell me which option you'd like.
